pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.0.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. I.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Verañjāyaṃ viharati Naḷerupucimandamūle mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.3: samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Verañjāyaṃ viharati Naḷerupucimandamūle mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.4: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.5: iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.6: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.7: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.1.8: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.2.1: atha kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.2.3: na samaṇo Gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuḍḍhe mahallake addhagate vayo anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.2.4: tayidaṃ bho Gotama tath' eva, na hi bhavaṃ Gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuḍḍhe mahallake addhagate vayo anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.2.5: tayidaṃ bho Gotama na sampannam evā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.2.6: nāhan taṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yam ahaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ vā paccuṭṭheyyaṃ vā āsanena vā nimanteyyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:1.2.7: yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa tathāgato abhivādeyya vā paccuṭṭheyya vā āsanena vā nimanteyya, muddhāpi tassa vipateyyā 'ti. ||2||

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.4: imissā bhante mahāpaṭhaviyā heṭṭhimatalaṃ sampannaṃ, seyyathāpi khuddamadhuṃ anīlakaṃ evamassādaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.5: sādh' āhaṃ bhante paṭhaviṃ parivatteyyaṃ, bhikkhū pappaṭakojaṃ paribhuñjissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.6: ye pana te Moggallāna paṭhavīnissitā pāṇā te kathaṃ karissasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.7: ekāhaṃ bhante pāṇiṃ abhinimminissāmi seyyathāpi mahāpaṭhavī, ye paṭhavīnissitā pāṇā te tattha saṃkāmessāmi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.9: alaṃ Moggallāna, mā te rucci paṭhaviṃ parivattetuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.11: sādhu bhante sabbo bhikkhusaṃgho Uttarakuruṃ piṇḍāya gaccheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.12: alaṃ Moggallāna mā te rucci sabbassa bhikkhusaṃghassa Uttarakuruṃ piṇḍāya gamanan ti. ||2||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.1: atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.2: katamesānaṃ kho buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi,

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.4: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.6: ahosīti. katamesānaṃ kho bhante buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi, katamesānaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.7: bhagavato ca Sāriputta Vipassissa bhagavato ca Sikhissa bhagavato ca Vessabhussa brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.8: bhagavato ca Sāriputta Kakusandhassa bhagavato ca Konāgamanassa bhagavato ca Kassapassa brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosīti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.1: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena bhagavato ca Vipassissa bhagavato ca Sikhissa bhagavato ca Vessabhussa brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.2: bhagavā ca Sāriputta Vipassī bhagavā ca Sikhī bhagavā ca Vessabhū kilāsuno ahesuṃ sāvakānaṃ vitthārena dhammaṃ desetuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.3: appakañ ca nesaṃ ahosi suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.5: tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā, te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippañ ñeva antaradhāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.6: seyyathāpi Sāriputta nānāpupphāni phalake nikkhittāni suttena asaṃgahitāni tāni vāto vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃseti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.9: evam eva kho Sāriputta tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā, te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippañ ñeva antaradhāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.10: akilāsuno ca te bhagavanto ahesuṃ sāvake cetasā ceto paricca ovadituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.11: bhūtapubbaṃ Sāriputta Vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho aññatarasmiṃ bhiṃsanake vanasaṇḍe sahassaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ cetasā ceto paricca ovadati anusāsati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.13: evaṃ manasikarotha mā evaṃ manas' ākattha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.15: atha kho Sāriputta tassa bhikkhusahassassa Vessabhunā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānānaṃ evaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.16: tatra sudaṃ Sāriputta bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti yo koci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.17: ayaṃ kho Sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena bhagavato ca Vipassissa bhagavato ca Sikhissa bhagavato ca Vessabhussa brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosīti. ||2||

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.1: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.2: etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.3: yaṃ bhagavā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeyya uddiseyya pātimokkhaṃ yatha yidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.4: āgamehi tvaṃ Sāriputta, āgamehi tvaṃ Sāriputta.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.6: na tāva Sāriputta satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti uddisati pātimokkhaṃ yāva na idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti. yato ca kho Sāriputta idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesañ ñeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.7: na tāva Sāriputta idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṃgho rattaññumahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.8: yato ca kho Sāriputta saṃgho rattaññumahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesañ ñeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.9: na tāva Sāriputta idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṃgho vepullamahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.10: yato ca kho Sāriputta saṃgho vepullamahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesañ ñeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.11: na tāva Sāriputta idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṃgho lābhaggamahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.12: yato ca kho Sāriputta saṃgho lābhaggamahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesañ ñeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.13: na tāva Sāriputta idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṃgho bāhusaccamahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.14: yato ca kho Sāriputta saṃgho bāhusaccamahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṃghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesañ ñeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.15: nirabbudo hi Sāriputta bhikkhusaṃgho nirādīnavo apagatakāḷako suddho sāre patiṭṭhito,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.16: imesaṃ hi Sāriputta pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ yo pacchimako bhikkhu so sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano 'ti. ||4||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Ānanda tathāgatānaṃ yehi nimantitā vassaṃ vasanti na te anapaloketvā janapadacārikaṃ pakkamanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.3: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.4: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā Ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena Verañjassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.5: atha kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Verañjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā etad avoca: nimantit' amhā tayā brāhmaṇa vassaṃ vutthā, apalokāma taṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.8: saccaṃ bho Gotama nimantit' attha mayā vassaṃ vutthā, api ca yo deyyadhammo so na dinno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.10: no pi adātukamyatā, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā, bahukiccā gharāvāsā bahukaraṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.11: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.13: atha kho bhagavā Verañjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.14: atha kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bho Gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.15: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Verañjassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.16: atha kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ticīvarena acchādesi ekamekañ ca bhikkhuṃ ekamekena dussayugena acchādesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.17: atha kho bhagavā Verañjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.18: atha kho bhagavā Verañjāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā anupagamma Soreyyaṃ Saṃkassaṃ Kaṇṇakujjaṃ yena Payāgapatiṭṭhānaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Payāgapatiṭṭhāne Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttaritvā yena Bārāṇasī tad avasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.19: atha kho bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.20: anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.21: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Vesāliyā avidūre Kalandakagāmo nāma hoti, tattha Sudinno nāma Kalandakaputto seṭṭhiputto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.2: atha kho Sudinno Kalandakaputto sambahulehi sahāyakehi saddhiṃ Vesāliṃ agamāsi kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.4: addasa kho Sudinno Kalandakaputto bhagavantaṃ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ, disvān' assa etad ahosi: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ pi dhammaṃ suṇeyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.5: atha kho Sudinno Kalandakaputto yena sā parisā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho Sudinnassa Kalandakaputtassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.7: yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.8: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.9: atha kho sā parisā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.10: atha kho Sudinno Kalandakaputto aciravuṭṭhitāya parisāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sudinno Kalandakaputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.11: yathā yathāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.12: icchām' ahaṃ bhante kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.14: anuññāto 'si pana tvaṃ Sudinna mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.15: na kho ahaṃ bhante anuññāto mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.16: na kho Sudinna tathāgatā ananuññātaṃ mātāpitūhi puttaṃ pabbājentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.17: so 'haṃ bhante tathā karissāmi yathā maṃ mātāpitaro anujānissanti agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.2.1: atha kho Sudinno Kalandakaputto Vesāliyaṃ taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena Kalandakagāmo yena mātāpitaro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā mātāpitaro etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.2.2: amma tāta yathā yathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.2.3: icchām' ahaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.2.5: evaṃ vutte Sudinnassa Kalandakaputtassa mātāpitaro Sudinnaṃ Kalandakaputtaṃ etad avocuṃ:
